name: The rooftops: a solo chapter 2 level of moving platforms
body: The playthrough is the same street twice. Add a third level, `the rooftops` (chapter 2, the bright look): a solo level with no companion, built from moving platforms across wide gaps, a solo swing arc and a few gems, ending in a goal. The streets now lead to the rooftops and the rooftops to `streets-later`, so a first playthrough runs chapters 1, 2 and 3. It is also reachable from the main menu. Game code and world file only; no renderer or engine change.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, for slice 5, from the coordinator's request to keep growing the platformer.
Done: rooftops world, menu button, streets -> rooftops -> streets-later, keyboard test the-rooftops-ride-the-platforms, docs and D-077.

acceptance_criteria: The streets' goal loads the rooftops and the rooftops' goal loads streets-later
The main menu has a button for the rooftops
A headless keyboard test rides the moving platforms, swings, and reaches the goal
docs/crimson-and-thorn-slice.md has a slice 5 section and decisions.md has an entry
